verdict.rationale: MoonPay is an embedded fiat-to-crypto on/off-ramp provider: hosted widgets, SDKs, payment APIs and transaction webhooks. It has no user-authored automation or workflow layer whose versions could be reviewed or rolled back, so this story is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows MoonPay ships such a capability: its webhooks and test mode are payment-integration features, not automation versioning.
